captcha_body: Please confirm you are not a bot. This helps us stop abuse.
link_help: Use this link to manage your report and reply to messages, on any device. Keep it safe: without an email address we cannot recover it.
link_emailed: We have also emailed the link to you.
manage_private_note: This page is private. Do not share the link with strangers.
manage_unread: {count, plural, one {# unread message} other {# unread messages}}
under_review_body: Our team is reviewing your report. Until then it is not public.
closed_note: This report is closed. You can reopen it within 7 days.
link_invalid_body: The report may be closed or deleted. If you gave an email address, we can send you the link again.
expiry_note: {days, plural, one {The report expires in # day.} other {The report expires in # days.}} If the animal is still with you or you still see it, keep the report open.
outbox_pending_title: {count, plural, one {# report has not been sent yet} other {# reports have not been sent yet}}
outbox_pending_body: Send them now or delete them from this device. Deleted reports cannot be recovered.
outbox_send_failed: The reports could not be sent. Try again when you are online, or delete them.
